_note: Courses shown on the Classes tab. Listed in the order given here. Fields: numbers (string, e.g. 'CS 1671 / CS 2071'), title, url (optional, links the title), level, focus, note (optional, small print under the focus). To add a course, append an object to `courses` — no code or CSS changes needed.

courses.title: Certificate in Computational Linguistics
courses.focus: A structured program of NLP and computational linguistics coursework completed alongside a bachelor's degree.

courses.title: Human Language Technologies
courses.focus: Introduction to NLP, with applications in speech recognition, dialogue, question answering, and machine translation.

courses.title: Introduction to Natural Language Processing
courses.focus: Computational approaches to syntax, semantics, and pragmatics using statistical and knowledge-based methods.

courses.title: Advanced Topics in Natural Language Processing
courses.focus: Selected NLP research topics and recent advances; content varies by offering.

courses.title: Introduction to Computational Linguistics
courses.focus: Practical language processing with Python and NLTK, including tagging, parsing, classification, and corpus exploration.

courses.title: Data Science for Linguists
courses.focus: Processing linguistic datasets, text analytics, statistical language modeling, and machine learning.

courses.title: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Their Applications
courses.focus: Evolution of NLP, neural language models, transformers, and social and ethical issues surrounding LLMs.
